subject: general
question: Dear money refers to money that is hard to obtain due to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**high rate of interest**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dear money policy **refers to a **monetary policy **by the **central bank**.
 
• The **central bank **sets **high-interest rates **so that **credit is not easily available **to the **general public **in order to **decrease the rate **of inflation in the economy by **curbing demand**.
 
• **Dear money **refers to **money that is hard to obtain **(e.g. by borrowing) because of abnormally **high-interest rates**.
 
• This is because people prefer to **save when interest rates are high **and **spend or borrow when rates are low**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A dear money policy **would cause **RBI to release less amount of money **to **the public **which can only happen if the **borrowing rates are increased **for the public.
 
• The **4 different types of money **as classified by the economists are **commercial money, fiduciary money, fiat money, and commodity money**.
 
• Money whose **value comes from a commodity **of which it is made is known as **commodity money**.
